items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Ben Burnie was the MC, you know, that's when they're having those stage shows.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's wonderful. Those old Gold Cat records you can hear him.

He was the first guy to slobber around here. We had a guy with Ben Burnie. Ben Burnie was the MC, you know, that's when they're having those stage shows. So this Russian bass player is in the pit, see? So he says, uh, show me how Steve Brown slaps the bass. And I was like, boom, boom, boom, and slap back. So he's going down and he's playing an overture with Ben Burnie. And all of a sudden, in a quiet spot, this guy starts slapping the heck out of a bass and he breaks everybody up.
